# Claim size

**How big a claim do we make?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C7


## Small, sincere, provable
<a id="small-sincere"></a>

A modest claim the viewer can check. It is believable because it isn't big.

**Looks like:** 'This cut my render time from 4 minutes to 3.' The timer is shown on screen. Nothing is 'insane'; the number does the work.

**Good at:** trust; credibility over time; saves

**Weak at:** less thumb stop; can feel low-energy

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, carousel, yt-long · niches all · goals trust, saves · effort low

**How:** Run each line through visualize / falsify / nobody else. Show the proof object.

**Backed by:** [Small, sincere, believable claims](../topics/text.md#text-small-sincere-claim), [Visualize, falsify, nobody else can say it](../topics/text.md#text-three-rules), [State an honest limitation](../topics/story.md#story-honest-limitation), [Claim plus instant visual proof](../topics/hooks.md#hook-bold-claim-visual-proof), [Something new on screen every 1.2–2.5 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-change-every-1-5-2-5s) · sources L09, L02

## Bold claim, instant proof
<a id="bold-with-proof"></a>

A big claim in the hook, backed on screen within 2–3 s.

**Looks like:** 'Scientifically impossible to skip.' A retention graph appears at once. The boldness grabs attention and the proof keeps the trust.

**Good at:** thumb stop; retention; authority

**Weak at:** backfires if the proof is weak; claim inflation over time

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches all · goals reach, retention · effort medium

**How:** Prepare the proof graphic first. Cut to it on the claim's last word.

**Backed by:** [Claim plus instant visual proof](../topics/hooks.md#hook-bold-claim-visual-proof), [70 / 20 / 10 proven, iterate, experiment](../topics/growth.md#growth-70-20-10), [Expertise hook: years of niche in 60 seconds](../topics/hooks.md#l11-expertise-hook), [Lean: proof, pain/benefit or shock](../topics/hooks.md#hook-lean-three-ways) · sources L01, L03

## Best or worst: green or red, never grey
<a id="strong-take"></a>

Call something the best or the worst and defend it. Keep nuance for private work.

**Looks like:** 'Lamington Road is the worst place to buy your first PC.' Then two reasons and a story. People who disagree argue in the comments.

**Good at:** comments; reach through debate; memorable stance

**Weak at:** can damage trust if overdone; needs a belief you really hold

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches all · goals comments, reach · effort low

**How:** Talking head with a punch-in on the take. A 'hook, story, two points' script.

**Backed by:** [Strong take, then defend or teach](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-strong-take), [Green or red, never grey](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-polarise-green-red), [Contrarian statement or "don't buy X"](../topics/hooks.md#hook-contrarian-statement), [Warning hook: never start X without these N things](../topics/hooks.md#l11-warning-hook), [Teaching text: clean sans, red/green](../topics/text.md#text-clean-sans-teaching) · sources L06, L08

## Bold reel with an honest limitation
<a id="bold-plus-honest-limit"></a>

Make the strong claim, then admit one real limit ('the honest part...') so the rest is believed.

**Looks like:** Three tools sold hard, then: 'The honest part: it only ships 78 sounds.' The admission sits two-thirds of the way in and makes the earlier claims feel safe.

**Good at:** trust; balances hype; fewer 'this is fake' comments

**Weak at:** takes a few seconds; the limit must be real

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-long · niches all · goals trust, saves · effort low

**How:** Add one 'honest part' beat to the script. Mark it with a small text label.

**Backed by:** [State an honest limitation](../topics/story.md#story-honest-limitation), [Pause-and-play breakdown of a reel](../topics/ideas.md#l10-pause-and-play-breakdown), [Mix measured at −14 LUFS](../topics/sound.md#sound-loudness-minus-14), [Rahul: ~1 reel a day, two time slots](../topics/growth.md#growth-rahul-cadence) · sources L02

## Mixing
A strong take whose evidence is small and checkable gets both: a loud hook and a sincere body.

## Rule of thumb
Trust and saves: small sincere or bold-plus-limit. Comments: strong take. Thumb stop with proof ready: bold with proof.
